description: Search the EliteMobs, MagmaCore, BetterStructures, FreeMinecraftModels, CannonRTP and ResurrectionChest source code for a query. By default searches every mirrored repo by file content (grep). MagmaCore contains shared core functionality (Lua engine, base entity tables, scripting helpers) used by every plugin — always check it for hooks, helpers, or context methods that feel like they should be common across plugins. FreeMinecraftModels (freeminecraftmodels) has its own LuaItemTable / LuaPropTable and prop-specific hooks. Use this BEFORE answering plugin-specific questions or generating Lua/YAML files.

mode.description: "content" (default) greps file contents; "path" matches file paths.

path_prefix.description: Optional. Restrict to a subdirectory like "src/main/java/".

query.description: Text or regex to grep for. Symbol names, hook names, error messages.

repos.description: Optional. Defaults to every mirrored repo.

name: search_plugin_source
